adjudication.notes: Dogfood grounded goal extraction for docs/vision/vision.md pinned at commit a27d248.

goals.statement: TKS avoids building document editing UX, IDE markdown editors, or prompt canvases.

grounding.quote: TKS does not build Markdown editing environments, IDE extensions for authoring, or prompt-crafting canvases that compete with Spec Kit, Kiro, or native IDEs.

acceptable_paraphrases: Do not develop rich text document editors or authoring interfaces.

goals.statement: TKS avoids speculative code-level reverse engineering or inventing unwritten requirements from ASTs.

grounding.quote: TKS does not parse raw programming language ASTs to speculate about architectural intent, reverse-engineer unwritten requirements, or invent business contracts from code heuristics.

acceptable_paraphrases: Never infer business intent speculatively from raw source code syntax.

goals.statement: TKS avoids seeking formal regulated-industry ALM certification or replacing conformity assessment bodies.

grounding.quote: TKS does not seek formal certification or replace accredited third-party conformity assessment bodies

acceptable_paraphrases: Do not attempt accredited DOORS or ISO 26262 replacement.

goals.statement: The core substrate engine avoids in-engine generative text ghostwriting or unconstrained documentation generation.

grounding.quote: The core TKS engine and background services do not generate, paraphrase, or ghostwrite engineering documentation.

acceptable_paraphrases: Core engine must not autonomously author prose documentation.

goals.statement: TKS avoids premature multi-tenant cloud hosting and organization billing complexity in early phases.

grounding.quote: TKS avoids the operational and architectural overhead of multi-tenant cloud hosting, organization partitioning, and billing systems during early phases, prioritizing single-engine local or containerized deployments.

acceptable_paraphrases: Prioritize local containerized deployment over cloud SaaS multi-tenancy.

goals.statement: Human supervisory oversight remains grounded in tractable cognitive review granularity rather than fatigue.

grounding.section: The Monolithic Diff Dilemma (The Human Review Bottleneck)
grounding.quote: human oversight must be grounded in tractable supervisory granularity.

acceptable_paraphrases: Supervisory workload remains cognitively manageable for human engineers.

goals.statement: Curation effort is strictly bounded, preserving human supervisory capacity across engineering cycles.

grounding.quote: Curation effort is strictly bounded, preserving the Supervisory Queue Economy and preventing human review exhaustion.

acceptable_paraphrases: Prevent human reviewer burnout through bounded curation demand.

goals.statement: Adopters retain absolute ownership and data portability over their engineering intent without vendor lock-in.

grounding.quote: Adopters retain absolute ownership of their engineering intent and audit trails, with zero vendor lock-in.

acceptable_paraphrases: Users maintain unconstrained sovereignty and exportability over stored intent.

goals.statement: TKS coexists harmoniously with legacy enterprise systems of record rather than requiring disruptive replacement.

grounding.quote: TKS is designed to coexist with these systems, establishing bridges to open interchange standards (such as OMG ReqIF and OASIS OSLC) while serving as the high-speed operational intent substrate for autonomous agents.

acceptable_paraphrases: Support interoperability and bridge integration with existing ALM platforms.

goals.statement: Structured intent elicitation rails empower users to articulate and ground their own engineering goals.

grounding.section: The Vision Articulation Gap (Fuzzy Intent Before Requirements)
grounding.quote: bridging it requires structured intent elicitation rails that help users articulate and ground their own goals.

acceptable_paraphrases: Elicitation scaffolding assists users in externalizing their latent system intent.

goals.statement: Autonomous agents retain full creative freedom during code synthesis without generating graph curation noise.

grounding.quote: Agents retain full creative freedom during implementation without generating spurious graph bookkeeping or curation noise.

acceptable_paraphrases: Preserve agent flexibility beneath governed design boundaries.

goals.statement: TKS maintains standardized, backward-compatible MCP and REST contracts to prevent interface churn.

grounding.quote: Standardized, versioned, and backward-compatible Model Context Protocol (MCP) and REST contracts, ensuring external agent runtimes, CI pipelines, and IDE integrations never experience breaking schema churn.

acceptable_paraphrases: Keep public API and MCP schemas stable across releases.

goals.statement: TKS models and governs intent down to the architecture and design boundary while leaving lower-level code unmodeled.

grounding.quote: TKS models and governs intent down to the architecture and design boundary: requirements, decisions, interface and service contracts, invariants, and process obligations.

acceptable_paraphrases: Restrict graph governance to architectural and contract boundaries.

goals.statement: Intent flows unidirectionally from documented specifications to code, with reverse drift detected via verification signals.

grounding.quote: Intent flows from documented artifacts to code, with reverse drift detected strictly through verification signals.

acceptable_paraphrases: Detect code drift through tests and CI verification rather than reverse AST parsing.

goals.statement: Property graph scale remains proportional to architectural contracts rather than raw lines of source code.

grounding.quote: Graph size scales with architectural complexity and contract surface area, rather than raw lines of code.

acceptable_paraphrases: Ensure graph size scales with architectural complexity rather than code volume.

goals.statement: Engineer an agent-agnostic knowledge substrate anchoring external agents to a unified version-governed property graph.

grounding.quote: Engineer an agent-agnostic knowledge substrate that anchors external AI agents and human teams to a unified, version-governed property graph, establishing end-to-end traceability and bidirectional coherence across institutional knowledge, operational processes, architectural requirements, and executable code

acceptable_paraphrases: Construct an authoritative property graph linking specifications, processes, and code.

goals.statement: Extract baseline requirements and specifications from brownfield artifacts via zero-token mechanical parsers.

grounding.section: The Specification Void & The Cold-Start Adoption Barrier (The Upstream Intent Prerequisite)
grounding.quote: TKS directly confronts the cold-start adoption barrier through **Brownfield Intent Scaffolding**: leveraging zero-token mechanical parsers to extract baseline requirement, decision, and specification nodes directly from these existing artifacts.

acceptable_paraphrases: Scaffold initial graph nodes from existing ADRs and API schemas without LLM tokens.

goals.statement: Supply cognitive planning rails to ground human-directed agent task elaboration within architectural contracts.

grounding.section: The Planning Desert & Cognitive Rail Vacuum (Strategic Elaboration Blindness)
grounding.quote: the substrate must supply **cognitive planning rails**: structured multi-axis planning context that bounds and grounds human-directed task elaboration, ensuring that agent proposals adhere strictly to architectural invariants, schema contracts, and implementation precedents.

acceptable_paraphrases: Provide multi-axis context rails for agent planning and task breakdown.

goals.statement: Bind static analysis and compliance tool outputs directly to governed requirements and process obligations in the graph.

grounding.section: The Build-vs-Leverage Imperative (Operational Intent Substrate vs. Code Orchestration, Spec-Driven Development & Retrospective ALM)
grounding.quote: binding those tools' outputs directly to governed architectural requirements, interface contracts, and process obligations** within the version-governed property graph.

acceptable_paraphrases: Link external scanner and verification results to architectural nodes.

goals.statement: Operate strictly on externalized intent artifacts to avoid speculative reverse-engineering hallucinations.

grounding.section: The Specification Void & The Cold-Start Adoption Barrier (The Upstream Intent Prerequisite)
grounding.quote: TKS operates on externalized intent artifacts, avoiding the fragility and hallucination risks of speculative code-level reverse-engineering.

acceptable_paraphrases: Anchor reasoning strictly to recorded intent documents and schemas.

goals.statement: Scaffold requirements mechanically from Spec-Driven Development files including Spec Kit and Kiro steering files.

grounding.section: The Build-vs-Leverage Imperative (Operational Intent Substrate vs. Code Orchestration, Spec-Driven Development & Retrospective ALM)
grounding.quote: deliberately *embracing and leveraging* SDD artifacts as native input sources via Brownfield Intent Scaffolding rather than competing on authoring UX.

acceptable_paraphrases: Ingest SDD markdown files as first-class input sources for requirement nodes.

goals.statement: Model and govern institutional operational engineering procedures alongside functional software requirements.

grounding.section: The Procedural & Topological Void (Absence of Process and Cross-Layer Gap Blindness)
grounding.quote: Software engineering is fundamentally more than a static cascade of functional requirements; it is equally governed by operational procedures, engineering workflows, and cross-layer architectural coherence.

acceptable_paraphrases: Incorporate procedural obligations and workflows into the living knowledge graph.

goals.statement: Detect topological architectural gaps where presentation actions lack corresponding domain logic and contracts.

grounding.section: The Procedural & Topological Void (Absence of Process and Cross-Layer Gap Blindness)
grounding.quote: When traversing a user workflow, engineering teams expect presentation-layer actions to link systematically to corresponding functional specifications, domain logic, and service contracts.

acceptable_paraphrases: Flag missing cross-layer links and systemic omissions in the architecture graph.

goals.statement: Provide traceable compliance evidence across the entire requirement-to-release commit lifecycle.

grounding.quote: TKS serves as an authoritative, version-governed system of record for **traceable compliance evidence** (requirement → decision → interface contract → verification run → release commit, bound to institutional process obligations)

acceptable_paraphrases: Maintain an immutable audit trail from intent through test runs to release commits.

gaps.description: Data portability softgoal VG8 has no operational export format verification test suite.
Tension between strict non-goal on editor authoring VG1 and native SDD file parsing support VG21.
